steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 2 problems in 9 items
details: The Critic objected to the understandable business rationale: it says "grocery" and "convenience stores" and "home improvement", which the quoted sentences don't show.

The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The quotes state a dividend policy but do not provide the specific dividend amount paid in 2025, failing the quantification requirement.

steps.title: Critic sent 2 findings back for repair
details: Understandable business: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).
Rational capital allocation: constrained retry (the agent must cite something new or lower its verdict).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for understandable business: 345 tokens in, 55 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The company acquires and manages freestanding commercial properties, leasing them to a diverse base of creditworthy operators under long-term net lease agreements. It generates revenue through contractually defined rental payments, which often include embedded rent escalations.
